description: Τμήμα Διαχείρισης Γεωχωρικών Δεδομένων Πόλεως: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Τμήμα Διαχείρισης Γεωχωρικών Δεδομένων Πόλεως. Coverage: Τμήμα Διαχείρισης Γεωχωρικών Δεδομένων Πόλεως. The listing groups 10 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Μετρό Γραμμή 4 (υπό κατασκευή); Σταθμοί Μετρό - Γραμμή 4 (υπό κατασκευή); Μέσα Μεταφοράς Σταθερής Τροχιάς (Μετρό, Τραμ, Προαστιακός, ΟΣΕ); Γραμμές Μετρό. Formats seen: PNG, PDF, WMS, GML, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License v1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
